scope: Checked extraction UX versus bounded SAT

findings.requirement: Retain sourceHash, revision, epoch and jobId freshness checks for all egraph presentations; optimize is read-only and must never replace editable Alloy source.

Certificate checking, saturation termination and bounded solver status are independent fields and UI labels. Budget-limited checked extraction remains sound but incomplete; failed replay must suppress checked equivalence claims.

Only mapper-produced anonymous typed IR, immutable slot identity, profile and rule identifiers may reach egraph artifact/features. Source text, names, display maps, provenance hash and raw exceptions are excluded.
Keep exact canonical payload/digest/features separate from extracted payload/digest/features. Label digests as integrity/provenance, not equivalence certificates.

Expose anonymous extracted payload, positive extraction costs, graph counts, fixed stop reason and proof summary with rule profile. Describe proof as checked certificate under supported rule profile; do not imply Java-Lean refinement.

browser_qa_required: Edit or replacement submit clears old optimized presentation
Stale source/hash/job response never shows extraction
CHECKED plus budget limit has checked label and distinct incomplete caption
Failed replay never displays checked equivalence
Anonymous output stable under alpha renaming and excludes source names
trust_limits: Approval covers frozen contract design, not implementation correctness or completion.
Two clean Lean builds and exact proposition closure are being performed by root; this review does not claim independently executing them.
Abstract Lean theorems do not establish parser mapping or Java implementation refinement.
Browser disconnected at initial review; no browser execution claimed.
contract_assessment: Optional CanonicalView.egraph preserves unchanged structural v1 bytes/features and prevents raw-source bypass.
Multi-island numeric occurrence root paths, immutable inventory and captured same-traversal AST/subtree pairings address anonymous identity and binder ordinal hazards.
Separate per-island certificateStatus and stopReason plus bounded graph/proof previews satisfy independent evidence presentation.
Unit tree-occurrence costs and no-more-costly extraction support honest UI reduction summaries without optimality claims.
Strict certificate replay binds trusted original input/context/inventory rather than accepting self-asserted proof metadata.

MixedFormula/MixedDerivation and mixed_sound explicitly connect Boolean substitutions and SOME/NO relational congruence; runtime full-schema carrier correspondence remains an admitted implementation trust boundary.
34 forward registry mappings reviewed against declared Boolean and relation constructors; finite semantic parity tests remain implementation acceptance.
implementation_notes: Before frontend work, freeze actual DTO property types for term, graphPreview, graph statistics, proof summary, certificate, aggregate status and fixed unavailable reasons; specification currently describes these semantically rather than a JSON Schema.
Render each island certificate state independently. Aggregate status must never imply every island checked or every island saturated if truncated/failed/incomplete.
Graph preview truncation and module island truncation require distinct readable notices. Preview truncation alone must not rewrite engine stopReason.
Use native keyboard-accessible details/summary for graph/proof text and fixed enum label mappings; keep any certificate download anonymous and generated from current guarded result only.
Scope bounded solver disclaimer to solver result; explain local certificate checking in the egraph section.
